body.x: Swan Electronics, together with the Incheon Economic and TechnologicalInformation Techno Park, will be exhibiting at MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT &MIK NIGHT '(BOOTH # 52843) in EUREKA PARK, CES 2019, the world's largesttechnology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to showcase a27-inch open-type showcase and a 32-inch mirror display.
Swan Electronics is a manufacturer of transparent displays. Transparentdisplays look like glass, and at the same time, they can be combined intovarious fields.

The main features of Swan Electronics products are as follows. △ Direct display of various sizes of display panel △ Product can be produced with desired design △ Display product can be seen from various angles (4 sides open showcase) △ Mirror display with excellent visibility while maintaining mirror function

Swan Electronics official said, "Transparent and mirror displays, whichare widely regarded as the next generation of displays, provide a moreaesthetically pleasing living environment, but can also be extended to safety,security, consumption patterns, convenience, and healthcare through convergencewith the fourth industry. It has the potential for unlimited development".
"I would like to talk to industry representatives from variouscountries including the United States, China, Japan, etc., participating inthis CES."

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.

CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition wheretechnology companies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution willparticipate. The main categories are 3D Printing, Accessibility, Advertising,Marketing, Content and Entertainment, AR / VR and Gaming, ArtificialIntelligence and Robotics, Audio and Video , Baby Tech, CES Sports Zone,Country Pavilions, Design & Source Showcase, Digital Money, Drones,Enterprise Solutions, Eureka Park, Family and Kids Tech, Fitness, Health andWellness, Home Cinema, IoT Infrastructure, iProducts , Resilience, Self-DrivingTechnology, Sleep Tech, Smart Cities, Smart Home, Sports Tech, Tourism, VehicleTechnology, Wearables, Wireless Devices and Services.
